# Columns: A=0 (ID), B=1 (Impact), C=2 (Likelihood)

data_rows = df.iloc[2:16]

# Row 13 (index 12): Likelihood 2

# Col G (index 6): Impact 2
# Col H (index 7): Impact 3

matrix = {
    (11, 5): [], (11, 6): [], (11, 7): [], # Likelihood 3
    (12, 5): [], (12, 6): [], (12, 7): [], # Likelihood 2
    (13, 5): [], (13, 6): [], (13, 7): []  # Likelihood 1
}

for index, row in data_rows.iterrows():
    try:
        risk_id = str(int(row[0]))
        impact = int(row[1])

        col = 4 + impact
        # Map Likelihood (1,2,3) to Row (13,12,11)
        row_idx = 14 - likelihood
        
        if (row_idx, col) in matrix:
            matrix[(row_idx, col)].append(risk_id)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        continue

# Write the results back to the dataframe
for (r, c), ids in matrix.items():
    df.iloc[r, c] = ", ".join(ids)
